newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan man run over repeatedly.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan man run over repeatedly.

text.p: A Nicaraguan man was in stable condition in hospital on Monday after being run over repeatedly by several cars, none of which stopped to help him as he lay unconscious in the street for eight hours, a local newspaper reported.

The unidentified man, who had only one leg and apparently was indigent, was run over on a central Managua street at about 10 p.m. local time on Saturday and was not rescued by firefighters until 6 a.m. on Sunday, El Nuevo Diario reported.
The medical exam showed he had been run over by several cars, losing his one remaining leg in the process, the newspaper said.
Various passersby telephoned radio stations but no one took the man to hospital, El Nuevo Diario reported.
